mitigation_descriptions: Ensure strong password complexity, rotation, and hashing algorithms are enforced to mitigate the impact of dumped hashes.
Restrict sudo permissions and ensure users cannot run arbitrary commands capable of reading sensitive credential files.
Ensure permissions on /etc/shadow strictly restrict read access to root and appropriate system processes.
Manage user privileges and audit sudoers configuration to enforce principle of least privilege.
reasoning: The adversary successfully executed elevated commands to dump /etc/shadow via sudo on intranet-server, confirming credential access (T1003.008). Containment and credential rotation are immediately necessary to prevent lateral movement.
remediation_plan: 1. Isolate the affected host 'intranet-server' (10.35.35.206) from the network to prevent lateral movement. 2. Suspend or revoke active sessions and credentials for the compromised user account 'phopkins'. 3. Force an organization-wide password reset for all local accounts present in /etc/shadow. 4. Audit /etc/sudoers on 'intranet-server' to restrict phopkins and other non-admin accounts from executing commands that read sensitive system files. 5. Inspect host logs for any signs of subsequent lateral movement or persistence established using obtained hashes.
